overview.heading: Foil balloons from our Ahmedabad factory
paragraphs: Toyon Industry Private Limited is a foil balloon manufacturer in Odhav, Ahmedabad, Gujarat. We make {designs}+ foil balloon designs in {collections} themed collections and sell them straight from our factory for wholesale and bulk orders. The minimum order is 500 pieces.

Our buyers are wholesalers, party shops, gift shops and decorators who resell our balloons or use them at events. People mostly buy foil balloons for birthdays, baby showers, theme parties, school events and shop displays.
We check the material, print and seals on every order. Before anything is counted and packed, we also blow up sample balloons from each batch to test them.

qualityChecks.title: Material check
qualityChecks.body: We check the film before production starts, so every balloon begins with good-quality plastic film.

qualityChecks.title: Print & colour check
qualityChecks.body: We check the printed artwork for colour, sharpness and alignment, so the balloon you get matches the design you picked.

qualityChecks.title: Seal check
qualityChecks.body: After heat sealing, we look over the edges for gaps or weak spots that could let air out.

qualityChecks.title: Inflation test
qualityChecks.body: We blow up sample balloons from each batch to make sure the shape is right and they hold air.

qualityChecks.title: Counted & packed clean
qualityChecks.body: Balloons are counted, folded flat and packed clean, so your order is ready to sell or use when it arrives.

faqs.question: What are foil balloons made from?
faqs.answer: They are usually made from thin plastic film, such as nylon or PET-based laminates, with layers chosen to suit the design and finish. For the products you are interested in, check the exact material and intended use with Toyon.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.answer: The minimum order is 500 pieces. Add the designs and quantities you have in mind to your enquiry.

faqs.question: Where is Toyon located?
faqs.answer: Toyon Industry Private Limited is based at A/6, Gaytri Ind. Estate, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382415, India.

faqs.question: What should I include in a manufacturing enquiry?
faqs.answer: Tell us which designs you have chosen, how many you need and what they are for, plus any material, printing, packaging or inspection requirements. We can then talk through what applies to your order.
